title: Introducing the Jasper MCP Claude Connector
summary: Jasper is now in the Claude Connector Marketplace. Generate on-brand content grounded in your brand voice, audience, products and company knowledge, right inside Claude.
body_markdown:
More of your team's day is happening inside tools like Claude. That was the top finding in[Jasper's State of AI in Marketing 2026](https://www.jasper.ai/state-of-ai-marketing-2026) , where 91% of enterprise marketing teams told us they now work with AI, up sharply from a year ago.


Generation is no longer the bottleneck. The blocker to high quality content is ensuring your brand - your voice, your facts, your taste,the guardrails that make everything your team produces sound unmistakably like you, are represented authentically. Without them, teams re-paste guidelines into every prompt, re-check everything that comes back, and all that speed buys is random acts of AI.


Today, that gap closes. The official Jasper connector is now available in the Claude Connector Marketplace, bringing Jasper's governance layer into the workflow where enterprise marketers already think, refine, and create.


If you read nothing else, read this: encode your brand once in Jasper – brand voices, audiences, style guides, knowledge as context, product details – and it travels with your team into Claude, along with Jasper agents, including for GEO and multi-language translation. Claude's reasoning, Jasper's governance.


## **Marketers face an AI paradox.**


For two years, marketers have relied on AI to move faster: account research, meeting summaries, drafts, briefs, blogs, listicles. It delivered speed. It partially delivered scale. But brand governance remains elusive. To my fellow CMOs: if your brand isn't consistent across all content, what's the point of speed and scale?


We’re producing more content than ever, and according to[Forrester](https://www.forrester.com/report/to-survive-the-content-apocalypse-reinvent-your-content-operating-model-now/RES191078) , up to 75% of this content is waste. In the same research, Forrester warns that "unguided genAI adoption accelerates the spread of mediocrity." You know this story.


In practice, creating content is a prompt and a tab switch. You draft a brief in Claude, jump to another tool, tell yourself you'll check the style guide, and send it for approval. Brand dilutes twice: first because the brand guide is a static PDF nobody opens, then again in redlining, where every reviewer sands off another edge. That's why AI copy reads generic, and why a distinct voice is now the only thing separating you from everyone else using the same models.


Jasper's MCP connector closes that gap. Your voice, guidelines, and approved messaging come with you into Claude. Governance stops being a checkpoint at the end of the workflow and becomes a part of the work itself.


## **Scaling your brand across content is achievable. And crucial for AI search visibility.**


In a June 2026 report,[Forrester warned](https://www.forrester.com/report/the-content-creation-and-optimization-solutions-landscape-q2-2026/RES197217) that "content and marketing decision-makers face a compounding risk: the appearance of scale without the governance to sustain it and of visibility without the optimization discipline to earn it." The challenge isn't creating AI content. That problem is solved. The challenge is that everything you ship still has to sound like you wrote it. Nothing in most marketers’ current workflows guarantees that.


AI search is what makes the gap visible. Answer engines don't reward the most content; they reward the most consistent. A model cites what it can corroborate: the brands described the same way on their site, in analyst coverage, in reviews, in docs will win. Say it five different ways and the model picks whoever said it clearly, often a competitor. Gartner's Marketing Symposium keynote said it in four words: "More is more waste."


Jasper stands apart by embedding brand context before generation. Content arrives on-brand, cutting review loops instead of adding them. A[Forrester Total Economic Impact](https://tei.forrester.com/go/Jasper/MarketingAI/?lang=en-us) study found a 50% reduction in brand-review rework, and a 342% ROI over three years.


Jasper's internal data backs this up: customers report 95% content alignment to style guides, 10,000+ hours saved from agentic workflows, and up to 70% increases in clickthrough rates. One enterprise customer localized 65,000 pieces of content across 1,200 products and 20 languages in a single run using[Jasper's Translation Agent](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/heyjasperai_the-jasper-translation-agent-is-here-activity-7480606727864877056-OoiV?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAACHaBMBRmUKPW3ADnKp6__4Q6JGQLYG-fk) , hitting a 99.7% success rate while keeping brand voice, terminology, and market nuance intact.


Speed and scale are within reach, but it all starts with brand governance. Jasper ensures what you create in Claude carries the same voice, facts, and guardrails everywhere, no matter who's prompting.


> *“Claude Cowork has changed how knowledge work is done forever, and our partnership with Anthropic reflects our ambition to have a similar impact on enterprise marketing teams. Being in the Claude Connector Marketplace puts Jasper right where those teams are already working, so the models they rely on create content that is unmistakably theirs.” ‍* **—Timothy Young, CEO, Jasper**


## ‍ **Claude brings the reasoning. Jasper brings the brand.**


Out of the box, Claude reasons and writes well. What it does not have is your brand voice, your audiences, or your approved facts. That is the gap Jasper IQ fills. Connect Jasper and your brand context comes with it:


- **Brand voice.** How your brand sounds, applied to every draft.
- **Audience.** Who you are speaking to, so the framing fits the segment.
- **Product details.** Descriptions, specs, claims and disclaimers ensure product language is preserved.
- **Knowledge base.** Your approved facts and source material, so claims are grounded.


The result: instead of coaching Claude toward your voice and hoping the draft lands, you get output that reflects your brand and your facts from the first pass, because the context is doing the work, not the prompt.


MCP is an open standard, so Jasper works in the same conversation as the other tools you have connected to Claude. Pull a brief from your docs, generate the on-brand draft with Jasper, ground the claims in your knowledge base, then route it, all in one thread.


> *“Governance is the core of what Jasper does: making sure every piece of content reflects a brand's voice, its facts, and its rules, and we are doubling down on our investment in that layer. Building on Model Context Protocol is how that governance travels into Claude, and because it is an open standard, we will keep extending those controls as teams work across more surfaces.”* **—Guhan Venguswamy, Field CTO, Jasper**


## **Governance travels with the work.**


The obvious worry: if generation moves into a chat window, doesn't control move out of marketing? It's the opposite. The connector extends your controls into Claude rather than routing around them. The same brand voice, approved facts, and guardrails that govern content in Jasper govern what gets generated in Claude, so nothing ships off-brand just because it started in a chat. The surface changes. The standard doesn't.


## **What your team can do on day one**


The fastest way to feel the difference is to run one of these today. These are just three jumping off points, but the pattern holds across marketing teams and projects:


- [AI Search](https://www.jasper.ai/geo) **: content built to be found in AI answers.** “Rewrite this page to answer the questions buyers ask AI tools, with clear structure and our approved facts.” Content, and overwhelmingly *written content* , is the source material for AI answers now, and the brands that get cited are the consistent, accurate, well-structured ones.
- [Multichannel campaigns](https://www.jasper.ai/solutions/campaigns) **: from brief to on-brand draft.** Point Jasper at your brief: “Draft this launch blog in our brand voice for our enterprise audience, using our GEO product one pager.” An on-brand draft comes back, grounded in your knowledge base.
- [Product launch](https://www.jasper.ai/grid) **: one message, every asset.** “Turn this launch brief into an announcement, five LinkedIn posts and a customer email series for our enterprise audience.” One source, one voice, many assets.


## **Two shifts, one conclusion**


Two shifts are happening at once. Marketing work is moving into assistants like Claude, and buyers are increasingly getting answers from AI instead of ten blue links. Both raise the stakes on written content because it's the raw material those answers are built from. The brands that win will be the ones engineering how they show up, everywhere the work lands, for human buyers and AI engines alike.


## **How to connect**


**Claude (web or desktop).** Open Settings, go to[Connectors](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/jasper) , find Jasper in the directory, and connect your Jasper workspace.


A good first prompt once connected: *“What can you pull from my Jasper workspace?”* From there, point Jasper at a brief, an audience, or your knowledge base, and ask for the asset. Iterate in the conversation.


If your team already works in Claude, this is one connection away. Connect Jasper and see what on-brand at scale feels like when the thinking and deliverable share a conversation.


***See how Jasper brings governed, on-brand content into every surface your team works in.***


Go deeper:[how Jasper and Claude work together](http://jasper.ai/blog/jasper-claude) , when to use each, and when to use both.


## **Frequently asked questions**


***Why is brand governance important?*** *‍*


Governance keeps AI content accurate and on brand as more people create more of it. Without it, your brand starts to drift, and off-brand copy or inaccurate claims slip through. At enterprise scale, that becomes compliance risk and lost trust, repeated across every market and channel. A platform with governance built in, like Jasper, applies your brand voice, approved facts, and guardrails to everything created, so quality holds no matter who is behind the keyboard.


***How do I connect Jasper in Claude?*** **


In Claude web or desktop, open Settings, go to[Connectors](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/jasper) , find Jasper, and connect your Jasper workspace. Full steps in our[developer docs](https://developers.jasper.ai/docs/jasper-mcp-server) .


***What can Jasper do inside Claude?*** *‍*


Generate on-brand content grounded in your Jasper IQ context, your brand voice, audiences, style guides, and knowledge base, and run Jasper agents, right inside Claude.


***How is this different from asking Claude to write in my brand voice?*** **


Claude on its own doesn't have your voice, audiences, or approved facts. Jasper brings that context into the generation, so output is on-brand and grounded from the start rather than approximated.


***Does it work with the other tools I've connected to Claude?*** **


Yes. MCP is an open standard, so Jasper composes with your other connected tools in the same conversation, from pulling a brief to generating the on-brand asset to handing it off.


***Why does this matter for AI search visibility?*** **


The same practices that keep content on-brand at scale, consistent voice, grounded facts, clear structure, are what AI engines use to decide what to cite. Governance and AI visibility share the same foundation.
